regs_note: Wyoming big-game seasons are set individually per hunt area — there is NO statewide general/regular season date for elk, deer, or bear, so those are null by design; only the Sep 1-30 special archery framework is consistent enough to report. Exact per-area dates live in the regulation PDFs and the WGFD Hunt Planner. Elk = 2026 Ch. 7, Deer = 2026 Ch. 6, Black Bear = 2026 Ch. 3. Duck reported is the most recent published 2025-26 (2026-27 not yet set). Nonresident fees read from the 2026 fee schedule — verify before publishing. Black bear is a general license (not a classic quota draw).
